title: P6 Chinese (PSLE)
description: Primary 6 / PSLE Chinese Language (MOE 小学华文课程标准2015; SEAB PSLE Chinese 0005 format): Paper 2 language use (拼音, 字, 词, 成语, 短语, 句子), 短文填空, 阅读理解一, 完成对话 and 阅读理解二 with 实用文 and 书面互动. English-first coaching around Chinese content, idiom cards.
subject: chinese
syllabus: MOE 小学华文课程标准2015 (华文, 小五至小六); SEAB PSLE Chinese Language 0005 (format for examination from 2017, examined in 2026)

topics.title: 语文应用 language use (汉语拼音、字、词、短语、句子)
完成对话 complete the dialogue
阅读理解二 实用文 and passage (open, with 书面互动)
试卷一 写作 composition (命题作文 or 看图作文)
口试 oral (朗读篇章, 会话)

archetypes.pattern: 汉语拼音: pick the tone-marked pinyin of an underlined word in a sentence; distractors change one tone, the initial or the final; 多音字 (着, 得, 长, 重) are favourites
字: a sentence with one missing character; same-sound or same-shape options, the radical decides (扣/叩/抠, 赞/暂/攒)
词: near-synonyms sharing a character (提醒/提高/提供/提出), fit-the-noun words (设施齐全), 关联词 pairs read from the partner word (即使……也)
成语: a context clue in the sentence (一会儿……一会儿……) points to one idiom; two options mean the opposite
短语: verb–noun collocation in a sentence frame (提高效率, 实现愿望, 克服困难, 达到目标); three options pair a verb with the wrong noun
句子: pick the correct sentence (病句: missing subject after 通过……使, wrong pair, 大约……多) or the meaning of a 反问句 (哪里是……)
短文填空: a 200-character everyday story with five numbered blanks; each blank's options are one word class (all adverbs, all ……心 words), the sentence around it decides
阅读理解一: a 350-character story with a turn; ask the cause, a feeling in other words, an effect, and the main message
完成对话: a phone call or counter conversation with four blanks; the line after each blank is the reply that decides it
实用文: an email or notice; ask for conditions, steps and deadlines, two ideas for two marks
书面互动: reply to the 实用文 in a short email that covers every point it asks for, in the right form and register
篇章: a family or community story; find-a-word from a named paragraph, why (隐含信息), a character trait with evidence
